description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) will host an in-person Proposers Day in support of the DARPA Program Solicitation (PS) for AMPED on May 13, 2026, at the DARPA Conference Center (DCC), Arlington, VA, from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET. DARPA anticipates releasing the PS prior to Proposers Day. If released, the PS will be made available at https://sam.gov/.
